source_acquisition.search_note: 自动 source inventory 将该 paper 标为 no_public_source_found。PDF 首页/正文的项目链接解析到官方 HyCa project page，页面标题和作者/论文标题匹配，静态图片与 PDF Figure 1–6、9–10 逐项视觉对应，因此状态改为 partial_visual_source。页面的 code 按钮仅指向通用 https://github.com，没有作者仓库或可编辑绘图/表格源；Figure 7–8、11–15 以及 Table 1–5 仍为 PDF-only。按 inventory 候选核查 black-forest-labs/flux 和 hpcaitech/Open-Sora 的 main recursive trees，没有 HyCa、该标题或对应 plot/figure/table/visual、ipynb、tex、tikz、pgf、svg 文件；完整标题和方法名的 gh repo search 也没有作者仓库命中。以上 source files 都是 rendered_asset，不将网页栅格图冒充 source_exact plotting code。

paper_style.palette_strategy: 图/表不是单一全局 palette：cluster/PCA/ARI charts 以浅蓝—深蓝区分 Cluster/分布，并常用红色 0.8 dashed threshold；qualitative grids 使用自然图像颜色、红色 HyCa/异常标注；Figure 3 使用 pastel green/blue/yellow process blocks；Tables 为黑白/灰色规则与粗体高亮。
paper_style.vector_raster_mix: 正文文字、表格规则和 caption 是 PDF 矢量对象；绝大多数 chart/qualitative panel 是嵌入栅格，Figure 3 和文字/箭头为矢量与栅格混合。pdffonts 显示正文 Nimbus/Computer Modern，并嵌有 Times New Roman、Cambria、Comic Sans、Calibri 等图内字体；未取得可编辑绘图源。
paper_style.style_consistency: 表格共享 grouped header、partial-grid、粗体/浅灰 HyCa 高亮，但实际表体约 6.4–8.2 pt；主文 chart 与附录 chart 共享蓝色 cluster/ARI 语义和 0.8 threshold。定性图的自然色、Figure 3 的 Comic Sans/pastel 和各页 raster palette 与正文 Nimbus serif 形成明显子系统，caption 标题粗体规则也不完全一致。

figures.label: Figure 3

caption.text: Figure 3: HyCa Framework. (a) Offline Preprocessing: feature dimensions are first analyzed and clustered with temporal indicators (e.g., differences, curvature). For each cluster, candidate solvers generate predicted features, then compared against real computed features; the solver with minimum error is then assigned to that cluster. (b) Inference: once assigned, each cluster consistently reuses its solver, enabling efficient prediction by skipping redundant computations while maintaining accuracy.

color.semantic_mapping: Orange/green/blue/yellow process blocks encode feature dimensions, indicators, clusters, and solver choices; arrows and labels provide shape/position redundancy.

encodings.x: Left-to-right processing order from feature space to indicators to clusters to solver.
encodings.y: Top offline branch versus bottom inference compute/skip lanes.
encodings.color: Block colors encode stage and output role; solver names are listed directly.
encodings.shape: Rounded rectangles and cluster boxes encode units; compute/skip boxes encode execution state.
encodings.line: Arrows encode processing/assignment; mini real-vs-predicted comparison uses adjacent boxes.
encodings.facet: Two panels: Offline Preprocessing and Inference; three cluster lanes in the lower panel.
encodings.text: D1–D8, I1–I8, C1–C3, solver names, timestep labels, and Compute/Skip text.

figures.data_and_statistics: 这是机制/接口示意图，不是测量图。可见的 D1–D8、I1–I8、C1–C3 和 token/timestep 示例用于说明流程，未给过滤率、预测误差数值或重复统计。
figures.evidence_relation: §3.2 把 feature caching 形式化为 ODE solving；Figure 3 将 offline probe、k-means cluster、solver selection 与 inference skip lanes 具体化，接着 Table 1–5 测量速度/质量，Figure 7 检验 solver pool 的必要性。
design_strengths: 上下两段明确区分“一次选择”和“全程求解”，与方法术语一一对应。
箭头、阶段框和直接标签使 cluster-specific solver assignment 无需先读公式。
design_weaknesses: Comic Sans 风格与正文/表格字体不一致，多个框内文字在双栏宽度下很小。
流程没有展示每个过滤/探测阶段的样本损失、选择稳定性或失败分支，caption 也没有定义所有 indicator。
figures.reusable_pattern: 采用“特征/指标→聚类→候选求解器→按 cluster 执行”双行流程，并在 inference lane 中显式区分 Compute 和 Skip；为复现增加输入规模、选择准则和失败路径。

figures.label: Figure 11

caption.text: Figure 11: The first row shows, from left to right, ARI comparison plots of FLUX, Qwen-Image, and Hunyuan Video under different prompts and timesteps, with the last plot illustrating ARI comparisons of FLUX across different resolutions. It can be seen that ARI distributions exceed 0.8 in most cases, confirming stable and consistent cluster assignments across prompts, timesteps and resolutions. An ARI above 0.8 indicates strong agreement and high clustering reliability. The three plots in the second row depict the intra-cluster metric shifts between clusters formed by indicators from every two adjacent prompts of FLUX. The normalized value is obtained by dividing the inter-cluster shift of a given indicator by the average value of that indicator within the cluster. It can be seen that most values fluctuate between -0.02 and 0.02, indicating excellent consistency of the metrics.

caption.text: Figure 12: Clustering consistency between original and LoRA-tuned models. Each subplot visualizes the clustering results under different prompts for FLUX.1-dev (top row), and its two LoRA variants, the Art LoRA (middle row) and Anime LoRA (bottom row). Despite fine-tuning, the cluster boundaries remain highly consistent across prompts and models, indicating that HyCa’s solver assignments remain stable and reusable even after LoRA adaptation.

color.semantic_mapping: Cluster 1/2 are dark/light blue; model rows and prompt headings supply text redundancy.

encodings.facet: Four prompts × FLUX.1-dev/Art LoRA/Anime LoRA rows.

figures.data_and_statistics: 与 Figure 8 同样的 12-panel PCA scatter grid，展示四个 prompt 下 base/Art LoRA/Anime LoRA 的 cluster geometry；没有新的 quantitative encoding 或 uncertainty。
figures.evidence_relation: Appendix A.5 对 main Figure 8 的重复/补充；Figure 13 用 ARI distributions 承担更强的 LoRA assignment evidence。视觉上与 Figure 8 高度相同，新增信息有限。
design_strengths: 保留 main LoRA 图的完整矩阵，便于补充材料独立阅读。
统一 cluster colors 与 prompt columns，跨页面对比成本低。
design_weaknesses: 几乎重复 Figure 8，未在 caption 或 panel 中指出这是 duplicate/extended view。
同样缺少 per-panel ARI、n 和差异量，定性边界判断不能单独检验。
figures.reusable_pattern: 附录应改用 difference/ARI summary，而不是重复整张 scatter grid；若保留，明确新增条件和与 Figure 8 的差异。

figures.label: Figure 13

caption.text: Figure 13: ARI between clustering assignments from FLUX.1-dev and its LoRA variants. (a) ARI distributions across different prompts and timesteps for FLUX.1-dev show clustering consistency within the base model. (b) and (c) compare the original model’s clustering with that from Art LoRA and Anime LoRA, respectively. In both cases, the ARI values remain high (most above 0.8, marked by the red dashed line), confirming strong agreement between the LoRA and original clustering results. This further supports that solver assignments in HyCa can be reused across LoRA variants.

color.semantic_mapping: Blue ARI distributions are split by comparison; red dashed 0.8 threshold and panel labels provide non-color cues.

encodings.color: Blue distributions for base/LoRA comparisons; red dashed 0.8.
encodings.facet: Three panels: base within-model consistency, Art LoRA comparison, Anime LoRA comparison.
encodings.text: Panel labels (a–c), model names, ARI axis and threshold.

figures.data_and_statistics: 三个 ARI histogram/KDE panels：base FLUX、Art LoRA、Anime LoRA；x 为 Adjusted Rand Index、y 为 Sample Count，红色竖虚线为 0.8，多数值高于该线。
figures.evidence_relation: Figure 8/12 的 visual cluster consistency → Figure 13 的 aggregate ARI evidence；支持 §5 “solver assignments can be reused across LoRA variants”，但没有列出 n 或 assignment mapping。
design_strengths: 把三种 LoRA 条件压缩为可比较的 ARI distributions，比重复 scatter 更适合汇总。
0.8 reference line 和 panel labels 让 comparison direction 明确。
design_weaknesses: 三 panel 的 histogram 统计量没有 n、bin width 或重复定义；caption 将 high ARI 作为稳定性 proxy，但未给决策前置。
蓝色 fills 和红阈线在灰度下不稳，缺少数值 summary/interval。
figures.reusable_pattern: 用 distribution summary 替代重复 geometry，固定阈线和 panel order；将 n、binning、ARI aggregation 和 exact model pairing写入 caption。

figures.label: Figure 14

caption.text: Figure 14: (a–b) The left two figures show that clustering structures remain stable under extreme resolution settings. (c–d) The right two figures show that clustering is also consistent for nonsensical prompts and closely matches those from normal, well-formed prompts.

color.semantic_mapping: Blue ARI histogram/KDE and red/purple 0.8 threshold encode condition-wise stability; condition names are direct text.

encodings.facet: Four conditions: 128×1024, 2048×2048, adversarial prompts, nonsensical prompts.

figures.data_and_statistics: 四个 ARI histogram/KDE panels覆盖极端窄/高分辨率、adversarial prompts、nonsensical prompts；共同使用 0.8 dashed reference，未给 n、bin 或误差。
figures.evidence_relation: Appendix A.7 将正文的 input-invariance 主张推向极端设置；Figure 15 接着把 early-step instability 作为边界/缓解条件可视化。
design_strengths: 条件名称直接写在 panel header，读者能快速识别压力测试维度。
同一 ARI 阈线贯穿四 panel，比较语法稳定。
design_weaknesses: caption 的 (a–b)/(c–d) 说明较短，没有定义 adversarial/nonsensical prompt 样本。
极端分辨率和 prompt 的样本量、reference assignment 及高 ARI 判据不透明；色彩在灰度下降级。
figures.reusable_pattern: 使用统一 threshold 的 stress-test small multiples，分别覆盖输入尺寸和语义异常；补充 exact prompt list、n 和 paired ARI definition。

figures.label: Figure 15

caption.text: Figure 15: (a) Although the clustering results at Step 49, Step 48, and Step 47 are inconsistent, the assignment at Step 47 already aligns closely with that at Step 35, suggesting that instability is limited to the first few timesteps in rare cases. (b) Despite this early-stage instability, the final generated image remains unaffected, as the first few steps are fully computed by the model and not involved in feature caching. Most predictors require at least three historical features, and caching typically begins at Step 4 or later—after cluster assignments have stabilized.

color.semantic_mapping: Blue/green cluster marks and centers encode early-step geometry; the right image and pale arrow/text provide a qualitative mitigation cue.

encodings.x: PCA principal component 1 in (a); no numeric x encoding in (b).
encodings.y: PCA principal component 2 in (a); no numeric y encoding in (b).
encodings.color: Cluster colors/centers in (a); green/blue natural image in (b).
encodings.shape: Cluster points and center × in (a); generated image in (b).
encodings.line: Arrow in (b) links early full-compute steps to unaffected final output.
encodings.facet: Two composite panels: four-step cluster snapshots (a) and a final generated image/arrow (b).
encodings.text: Step 49/48/47/35 labels, Cluster legend, Centers, and qualitative object labels.

figures.data_and_statistics: Panel (a) 是四个 early-step PCA scatter snapshots，展示 Step49/48/47/35 的 assignment；panel (b) 是一张 backpack/green apple qualitative image与箭头。caption 说明前 1–3 步 fully computed、cache 从 Step4 后开始，无统计区间。
figures.evidence_relation: Appendix A.7 先用 Figure 14 证明极端设置稳定，再用 Figure 15 明确 rare early-step failure boundary 和系统缓解；这给主文“one-time choosing”补充一个反例条件。
design_strengths: 把 failure case 与 mitigation 放在同一 composite figure，边界和实际影响同时可见。
Step labels、centers、legend 和箭头形成多通道编码。
design_weaknesses: (b) 的图像/箭头与 (a) 的坐标 scatter 视觉语法不一致，读者容易把 qualitative image 当作数据 panel。
caption 没有给 early instability 的发生率或具体 prompt 数，无法量化“rare”。
figures.reusable_pattern: 用左侧 failure geometry、右侧 downstream output 的 paired layout 说明“异常发生但不影响结果”；应同时报告 failure rate 和 cache-start policy。

cross_object_system.visual_narrative: 视觉叙事从 Figure 1 首页 montage 与 Figure 2 的异质轨迹/ARI 观察开始，经 Figure 3 的 offline cluster→solver→inference 接口，再用 Tables 1–5 覆盖 Qwen-Image、FLUX、HunyuanVideo、Qwen-Image-Edit 和 distilled models 的成本/质量，Figure 4/5 给 qualitative checks，Figure 6/7/8 给 geometry、solver-pool ablation 与 LoRA，Appendix Figures 9–15 给 distilled/video failure、ARI、极端条件和 early-step boundary。
cross_object_system.caption_system: 所有对象均采用 “Figure/Table n:” 起始并置于对象附近；Figure 2/3/7/8/12/13 与 Table 1–5 的标题短语使用粗体，其他 caption 多为普通字重。主结果表 caption 只有任务/模型标题，设置、aggregation 和不确定性留在正文；Figure 2/6/11/13/14/15 caption 写出主发现，但多数 qualitative caption 不自包含。
cross_object_system.table_header_system: 五张表都把 acceleration（Latency、Speed、FLOPs、Speed）与 task-specific quality 放在同一决策面，使用 ↑/↓ 方向符号、两层 grouped headers、方法列和浅灰/bold 行高亮。Table 1/5 加 Quality/Perceptual Metrics；Table 4 用 GEdit-CN/GEdit-EN 的 SC/PQ/OS 对称分组；Table 2/3 保留 Efficient Attention 开关；Table 4/5 的 footnote 负责缩写/reference convention。
cross_object_system.method_result_ablation_link: Figure 3 是方法接口，Table 1–5 是主成本/质量结果，Figure 4/5 是同任务 qualitative evidence；Figure 6/8/12/13 检验 cluster/LoRA 稳定性，Figure 7 是唯一直接的 solver-pool single-solver ablation，Figure 15 暴露 early-step failure boundary。没有 component deletion、k-sensitivity 或 offline overhead 的独立表/图。
cross_object_system.main_appendix_link: 主文 Figure 2/6/8 已提出 assignment invariance；Appendix Figures 9–10 扩展 distilled image/video visual quality，Figure 11 扩展 ARI/drift，Figure 12–13 重复并汇总 LoRA，Figure 14–15 检验 extreme settings 和 early-step mitigation。附录没有表格，且 Figure 12 与 Figure 8 高度重复，新增信息主要来自 Figure 13。
cross_object_system.typography_consistency: 正文/caption 主要为 Nimbus Roman No9 L 与 Computer Modern；表体使用约 6.4–8.2 pt Nimbus/CM；图内 plot labels 多为 Times New Roman/Cambria，Figure 3 使用 Comic Sans/Calibri，qualitative headers 又混入 Times。因此语义结构较统一，字体系统只有局部一致。
cross_object_system.color_consistency: blue/light-blue 是 cluster、ARI 和 PCA 的主要语义，red dashed 0.8 和 red HyCa/artifact labels 跨多对象复现；但 Figure 1/3 pastel 和 qualitative grids 的自然色不遵循同一 palette。多数 chart 依赖颜色区分，虽有 legend/row labels/threshold 等冗余，灰度安全性仍偏弱。

most_reusable_patterns: 用“动态轨迹/稳定性分布→方法接口→主结果→solver/LoRA/极端条件扩展”的视觉链把机制和应用证据串起来。
将 acceleration cost 与 task quality 放进同一 grouped table，并用固定方法行、方向箭头、bold/灰色高亮支持快速决策。
qualitative grid 固定 prompt 行和方法列；视频图用同一 prompt 的三帧对齐并以红框定位 failure。
在 appendix 用 ARI distribution、normalized drift 和 stress-test small multiples 追踪主文的 cluster invariance claim。
highest_value_objects: Figure 3：最清楚地把 one-time choosing/all-time solving、cluster-specific solver 与 compute/skip 执行连接起来。
Figure 7：把主比较与 single-solver ablation 放在同一坐标语法，是“solver pool 有必要”的直接视觉证据。
Tables 1–5：覆盖五个任务/模型族并将 latency/FLOPs 与质量指标放在同一决策面。
Figure 11 与 Figure 15：分别补足跨条件稳定性统计和 early-step failure boundary。
failure_patterns: 小字号和多列/多 panel 密度高，Figure 3、Figure 6–8、Table 1/2/5 在页面缩放下难读。
主表和大多数 qualitative 图没有重复、分母、区间或失败计数；ARI histogram 也未给 n/bin/aggregation。
颜色是许多 chart 的主 series channel，灰度可读性弱；红色 artifact/threshold 在低质量打印中可能消失。
Figure 8 与 Appendix Figure 12 几乎重复；caption 标题粗体和 self-contained 程度不一致，且没有公开原始 plot/table source。
final_judgment.one_sentence_visual_strategy: 论文以浅蓝 cluster/ARI 机制图和成本—质量 grouped tables 建立 HyCa 的可复用 solver 论证，再用 prompt 对齐的 qualitative grids 与附录 stress tests 展示跨任务质量和稳定性，但以高信息密度、点估计和有限可复现视觉源为代价。
